title: Breathing with the Seasons
subtitle: Mediterranean Annual Temperature Cycle (2018–2023)
description: Listen to the harmonic breathing of our planet. As Earth tilts throughout its orbit, observe how temperature rises every summer and falls every winter in a predictable annual cadence.

title: A Decadal Drift
subtitle: 24-Year Urban Climate Drift (2000–2023)
description: Track nearly a quarter-century of warming in the Tokyo basin. The sound gradually drifts upward across the decades, illustrating subtle yet steady long-term climate shift.

title: The Day the Heat Dome Broke Records
subtitle: 2021 Pacific Northwest Extreme Heat Anomaly
description: Experience the calm late spring of 2021 before an unprecedented atmospheric ridge locks over Western North America. Hear the pitch explode upward and trigger a sudden alert marker as temperatures cross 38°C (100°F).
